brief: Cashmere sweaters for $50, silk for $60, that sort of thing. Basically luxury materials without the markup. Broad audience, women 30+ is our best segment.

profile.business_summary: A direct-to-consumer apparel brand offering high-quality products made from luxury materials like cashmere and silk at affordable, direct-to-consumer prices without traditional retail markups.

relevant_tags.why: Their best-performing segment is women aged 30+.
The brand primarily sells sweaters and silk clothing.
Cashmere and silk garments are classic wardrobe staples.
Targeting women aged 30 and older aligns with mid-life demographics.
Silk and cashmere are highly relevant for professional and smart-casual workwear.
Sweaters and silk tops serve as premium wardrobe basics.

note_signals.why: Marlowe & Co. targets older affluent women who respond to quality messaging, matching this brand's luxury materials and 30+ female demographic.
Linden Park has a high-AOV apparel audience with a conservative/classic sensibility, making them prime candidates for affordable luxury materials.
Heartfoot has strong gifting season performance; high-quality cashmere and silk items at accessible price points are highly giftable.
Professional women demographic matches the target for upscale casual and workwear materials like silk.

profile.gate_reason: The product, price points, target demographic, and core value proposition are clearly defined, allowing for immediate campaign planning.

config.advertiser_summary: A direct-to-consumer apparel brand offering high-quality products made from luxury materials like cashmere and silk at affordable, direct-to-consumer prices without traditional retail markups.

assumptions: Margin not given; assumed 60% (typical for apparel) for the break-even estimate only.
Break-even per customer (guidance, not enforced): $50 x 60% x 1.1 orders = $33.00.

pricing.rationale: Pay per click: verifiable without trusting a pixel. Maximise conversions within the budget: bids move between $0.25 and the $1.80 cap (category default) to spend it well; no CPA target is invented. Guidance: at the assumed margin, a click is worth about $0.66; bidding above that loses money per customer. Set a target CPA or a lower max CPC to enforce it.
pricing.tcpa_unlock: tCPA unlocks after conversion tracking is verified and 50 click-through conversions are recorded.
